description: Records a person's decision on one Growth task (task_id, from read the work list), as the task's Outcome control does: on a check-in lap okay, negative (a concern, the legacy spelling also works), no_answer or checkin_stopped; on a review-chase task review_posted (the client posted a review; the same transition mark_review_posted makes) or declined (set do-not-ask); review_skipped ends this ask only, so a later good visit can still ask. It closes the task and its check-in through the SAME writers a classified reply uses, and records who decided. The `positive` outcome is not available to agents: it opens the review ask, which is a send a person decides in the app. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: record_feedback_outcome
title: Record a check-in or review outcome
